one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Pala (Kaia): all 89 UniV2 pools hold balance == reserves (skim=0, fork-verified), every admin/mint/migrate path reverts, farm emissions are gated behind owner-mintable REWARD/BURN LP tokens, and the $400k DefiLlama number is an off-chain artifact of the oUSDT-denominated lens; ~$67k of custody is LP-holder/staker recoverable (H-O).
